name: price_publication_intents
description: Durable requests to publish a catalog's current prices to a program, committed with the price change that caused them; the API's processor claims due ones under a lease and turns each into a new generation that changes only that catalog's prices.
lifecycle: Inserted or coalesced by a price change; claimed, retried and finished by the processor or re-authorized by a person. Finished rows are deleted 30 days after their last update, and rows go with their program or catalog.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the program and catalog; immutable (tenant key).
Program whose latest publication copies the catalog.
The catalog's price sequence of the newest change the intent publishes.
Membership that made the newest price change; kept as the change's author.
Membership that authorized the intent again after it was blocked or failed, whose authority the processor then checks.
columns.Null meaning: Nobody authorized it again; the author's authority is checked.

columns.Meaning: PENDING, PUBLISHED, SKIPPED (nothing to publish), BLOCKED (its authority was removed) or FAILED.
Stable code of why the intent was skipped, blocked or failed, or of its last transient failure.
columns.Null meaning: Nothing to explain: pending without failures, or published.

columns.Meaning: When a pending intent is next due.
End of the current processing claim.
Publication the intent produced, or the current one it found already including its prices.
columns.Null meaning: No publication yet, or none applies.

columns.Meaning: When the first change of the intent was committed.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, author_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The author is a membership of the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, authorized_by_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The re-authorizing member belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, catalog_id) REFERENCES catalogs(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The catalog belongs to the same company; intents go with it.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The intent belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, program_id) REFERENCES programs(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The program belongs to the same company; intents go with it.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, publication_id) REFERENCES publications(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The publication belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((publication_id IS NULL) OR ((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PUBLISHED'::character varying, 'SKIPPED'::character varying])::text[]))))
constraints.Purpose: Only published and skipped intents name a publication.
An intent follows at least one counted price change.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'PUBLISHED'::character varying, 'SKIPPED'::character varying, 'BLOCKED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying])::text[])))
CREATE INDEX price_publication_intents_catalog_idx ON public.price_publication_intents USING btree (company_id, catalog_id, created_at DESC)
constraints.Purpose: Lists a catalog's recent intents for the panel.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX price_publication_intents_company_id_id_key ON public.price_publication_intents USING btree (company_id, id)
CREATE INDEX price_publication_intents_due_idx ON public.price_publication_intents USING btree (next_attempt_at) WHERE ((state)::text = 'PENDING'::text)
constraints.Purpose: Due pending intents, in claiming order.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX price_publication_intents_finished_idx ON public.price_publication_intents USING btree (updated_at) WHERE ((state)::text <> 'PENDING'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX price_publication_intents_one_pending ON public.price_publication_intents USING btree (company_id, program_id, catalog_id) WHERE ((state)::text = 'PENDING'::text)
constraints.Purpose: One pending intent per program and catalog; later changes coalesce into it.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX price_publication_intents_program_idx ON public.price_publication_intents USING btree (company_id, program_id)
